maintainer.name: Expert
maintainer.desc: Deep experience in this language and domain. Would catch subtle bugs in review.
maintainer.short: Deep experience in this language and domain.

maintainer.name: Experienced
maintainer.desc: Works professionally in this stack. Could write the whole project unaided.
maintainer.short: Works professionally in this stack. Could write it unaided.

maintainer.name: Capable
maintainer.desc: Can read, debug, and change all of the code. Needs help writing some parts.
maintainer.short: Can read, debug, and change all of it. Needs help writing some parts.

maintainer.name: Learning
maintainer.desc: Understands parts of the code. Relies on AI or others for much of it.
maintainer.short: Understands parts of it. Relies on AI or others for much of it.

maintainer.name: Non-programmer
maintainer.desc: Can't read the code in a useful way. Directs the work by describing results.
maintainer.short: Can't read the code in a useful way. Describes the results wanted.

share.label: None
share.name: None
share.desc: No code in the project was written by AI. Every line was written by people.

share.name: A Little
share.desc: 1–25% of the code. AI wrote pieces such as tests, boilerplate, or single functions.

share.name: Some
share.desc: 26–50% of the code. AI wrote whole features alongside code written by people.
share.short: 26–50%. Whole features, alongside code by people.

share.name: Most
share.desc: 51–75% of the code. AI wrote most features. People wrote or rewrote the rest.

share.name: Nearly All
share.desc: 76–100% of the code. People mostly direct and edit what AI writes.
share.short: 76–100%. People direct and edit what AI writes.

oversight.name: Verified
oversight.desc: Every AI change read line by line, understood, and tested, like human code. Also used when AI Share is 0.
oversight.short: Every AI change read line by line, understood, and tested.

oversight.name: Reviewed
oversight.desc: Every AI change read by a person before merge. Tests where practical.
oversight.short: Every AI change read by a person before merge.

oversight.name: Spot-Checked
oversight.desc: Some AI changes read. The rest checked by running the program or its tests.
oversight.short: Some changes read. The rest tested by running.

oversight.name: Tested Only
oversight.desc: AI changes not read, but tested before merge by running the program or its tests.
oversight.short: Not read, but tested before merge.

oversight.name: Unchecked
oversight.desc: Merged as generated, without being read or tested.

examples.desc: A long-running C library maintained by its original author. No AI-written code.
An expert uses an agent to write most of a new service, reads every diff, and keeps test coverage high.
A team's web app. AI suggestions are accepted in places and everything goes through normal code review.
A hobby project. AI writes the features. The author reads the tricky parts and tests the rest by hand.
A weekend app built entirely by prompting. AI's changes are committed as they come, without being read or tested.

inconsistent.reason: At level E, the person approving merges can't read the code in a useful way, so they can't have read every AI change. If someone more experienced reviews every change, rate that person in position 1 instead.
Verified means every AI change was read and understood. At level D, the person approving merges understands only parts of the code.
